brief: The CZ conference/award landscape for banking and payments is small, highly concentrated and unusually legible: a handful of recurring events (CARDFORUM run by the bank card association SBK, IT ve finančnictví, FIN (R)Evoluce, IT pro Finance) publish named partner, exhibitor and speaker lists year after year, and 2026 adds a new umbrella — Fintech Week CEE in Prague, 8-15 May, whose main partners are already public (Komerční banka, Visa with Flowpay, CzechInvest's Fintech Regulatory Sandbox), plus two hackathons including a Mastercard-backed one. The award layer is dense and triangulable: Mastercard Banka roku (18 categories), HN's Nejlepší banka, Zlatá koruna's Finanční akademie, Finparáda, and the two scheme awards (Visa Awards CZ, Mastercard CZ) which name specific implementations and the issuers/acquirers behind them — the single richest source of dated, case-study-grade partnership evidence in this cell. Discovery is well served by Czech-language pointers (FinTech Cowboys, Časopis Bankovnictví, SystemOnline's event calendar, Economia's events portal, CzechCrunch) plus two institutional rosters that give the demand side for free: ČBA's membership and the ČNB's new Národní fórum pro platby. The main weaknesses are that several award programmes were only reachable through syndicated press releases in this pass, that no stable CZ bank-hackathon results page was found, and that no organiser partner page has yet been fetched and parsed — the obvious next step.
